, NO_SCAN_TBO.OUT_SCAN_DATE_TIME , NO_SCAN_TBO.OUT_CLASS AS OUT_CLASS , TBI.CT AS CT , TBI.WT AS WT , COALESCE(TBI.IN_PLAN_NO, INPLAN.IN_PLAN_NO) AS IN_PLAN_NO , TBI.ORIG_IN_PLAN_NO , COALESCE(TBI.OD_JOB_NO, INPLAN.OD_JOB_NO) AS OD_JOB_NO , TBI.CUSTOMS_REPORT_NO AS CUSTOMS_REPORT_NO , TBI.CUSTOMER_CODE AS CUSTOMER_CODE , TBI.CUSTOMER_NAME AS CUSTOMER_NAME , COALESCE(TBI.SHIPPER_CODE, INPLAN.SHIPPER_CODE) AS SHIPPER_CODE , COALESCE(TBI.SHIPPER_NAME, INPLAN.SHIPPER_NAME) AS SHIPPER_NAME , COALESCE(TBI.CONSIGNEE_CODE, INPLAN.CONSIGNEE_CODE) AS CONSIGNEE_CODE , COALESCE(TBI.CONSIGNEE_NAME, INPLAN.CONSIGNEE_NAME) AS CONSIGNEE_NAME , COALESCE(TBI.NOTIFY_CODE, INPLAN.NOTIFY_CODE) AS NOTIFY_CODE , COALESCE(TBI.NOTIFY_NAME, INPLAN.NOTIFY_NAME) AS NOTIFY_NAME , COALESCE(TBI.DELIVERY_CODE, INPLAN.DELIVERY_CODE) AS DELIVERY_CODE , COALESCE(TBI.DELIVERY_NAME, INPLAN.DELIVERY_NAME) AS DELIVERY_NAME , TBI.FWD_CODE AS FWD_CODE , TBI.FWD_NAME AS FWD_NAME , TBI.REMARKS_1 AS REMARKS_1 , TBI.REMARKS_2 AS REMARKS_2 , TBI.REMARKS_3 AS REMARKS_3 , COALESCE(TBI.COMMODITY_ITEM_LOC, INPLAN.COMMODITY_ITEM_LOC) AS COMMODITY_ITEM_LOC , COALESCE(TBI.CD_TYPE, INPLAN.CD_TYPE) AS CD_TYPE , COALESCE(TBI.CD_USE_TYPE, INPLAN.CD_USE_TYPE) AS CD_USE_TYPE , COALESCE(TBI.ECM_TYPE, INPLAN.ECM_TYPE) AS ECM_TYPE , TBI.LAST_POD_STATUS AS LAST_POD_STATUS , COALESCE(TBI.AR_DATE, INPLAN.AR_DATE) AS AR_DATE , COALESCE(TBI.REGISTER_USER_ID, INPLAN.REGISTER_USER_ID) AS REGISTER_USER_ID , CASE WHEN (SELECT TOP 1 REFERENCE_NO_ID FROM TB_COM_FILE_SHARE WHERE FUNC_JOB_NO = TBI.OD_JOB_NO OR FUNC_JOB_NO = INPLAN.OD_JOB_NO) IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS FILE_SHARE , PKG_SCAN.SAMPLE_OUT_CT , PKG_SCAN.LOCATION_PLACE , PKG_SCAN.PACKING_NO AS STOCK_REMAIN_PACKING_NO FROM ( SELECT * FROM ( SELECT IT.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY IT.BL_NO ORDER BY IT.CARRYIN_DATE DESC, IT.CARRYIN_TIME DESC ) AS rn FROM TB_BMS_IN IT WITH (NOLOCK)
WHERE IT.CARRYIN_DATE >= CONVERT(CHAR(10), #{srchStartDate}, 120) AND IT.CARRYIN_DATE <= CONVERT(CHAR(10), #{srchEndDate}, 120)
) x WHERE rn = 1 ) TBI LEFT JOIN TB_BMS_IN_PLAN INPLAN WITH (NOLOCK) ON INPLAN.IN_PLAN_NO = TBI.IN_PLAN_NO OR INPLAN.IN_PLAN_NO = TBI.ORIG_IN_PLAN_NO LEFT JOIN ( SELECT IN_NO , Sum(OUT_CT) AS SOUTCT , Sum(OUT_WT) AS SOUTWT , MAX(OUT_SCAN_DATE_TIME) AS OUT_SCAN_DATE_TIME , MAX(OUT_CLASS) AS OUT_CLASS FROM TB_BMS_OUT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE 1=1
AND LAST_POD_STATUS <> 'BMS04'
AND OUT_SCAN_DATE_TIME = '1900-01-01 00:00:00'
GROUP BY IN_NO ) NO_SCAN_TBO ON TBI.IN_NO = NO_SCAN_TBO.IN_NO LEFT JOIN ( SELECT STRING_AGG(CAST(TBP.PACKING_NO AS VARCHAR(MAX)),',') AS PACKING_NO , TBP.IN_PLAN_NO , MAX(TBP.LOCATION_PLACE) AS LOCATION_PLACE , MAX(TBP.SAMPLE_OUT_CT) AS SAMPLE_OUT_CT FROM TB_BMS_IN_PLAN_PKG TBP GROUP BY TBP.IN_PLAN_NO ) PKG_SCAN ON TBI.IN_PLAN_NO = PKG_SCAN.IN_PLAN_NO OR TBI.ORIG_IN_PLAN_NO = PKG_SCAN.IN_PLAN_NO ) ,EXCELList AS ( SELECT TBST.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO AS TBST_CARGO_REFERENCE_NO, TBST.BL_NO AS TBST_BL_NO, TBST.CARRYIN_DATE AS TBST_CARRYIN_DATE, ISNULL(TBST.STOCK_CT,0) AS TBST_STOCK_CT, ISNULL(TBST.STOCK_WT,0) AS TBST_STOCK_WT FROM TB_BMS_STOCK_TEMP TBST ) ,SCANList AS ( SELECT TBSP.IN_PLAN_NO, COUNT(DISTINCT TBSP.PACKING_NO) AS SCAN_CT, MAX(TBSP.BL_NO) AS BL_NO, MAX(TBSP.PACKING_NO) AS PACKING_NO, MAX(TBSP.SCAN_RESULT) AS SCAN_RESULT, MAX(TBSP.SCAN_DATE) AS SCAN_DATE, MAX(TBSP.SCAN_TIME) AS SCAN_TIME, MAX(TBSP.STOCK_SCAN_SEQ) AS STOCK_SCAN_SEQ, MAX(PKG.PACKING_NO) AS SCAN_REMAIN_PACKING_NO FROM TB_BMS_STOCK_PKG_SCAN TBSP LEFT JOIN ( SELECT STRING_AGG(CAST(TBP.PACKING_NO AS VARCHAR(MAX)),',') AS PACKING_NO , TBP.IN_PLAN_NO FROM TB_BMS_STOCK_PKG_SCAN TBP GROUP BY TBP.IN_PLAN_NO ) PKG ON TBSP.IN_PLAN_NO = PKG.IN_PLAN_NO WHERE 1=1
AND SCAN_DATE + ' ' + SCAN_TIME >= #{srchScanStartDate} + ' ' + #{srchScanStartTime} AND SCAN_DATE + ' ' + SCAN_TIME <= #{srchScanEndDate} + ' ' + #{srchScanEndTime}
AND SCAN_RESULT = '완료'AND TBSP.IN_PLAN_NO > 0 GROUP BY TBSP.IN_PLAN_NO HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT TBSP.PACKING_NO) > 0 ) /**CommonMapper.pageTop 코드(WITH절이 앞에서 이미 사용되어 pageTop코드 직접 작성)*/ ,Main_CTE AS(
SELECT X.* FROM(
SELECT AA.*, COUNT(*) OVER() AS TOTAL_CNT, SUM(AA.SIMPLE_CNT) OVER() AS TOTAL_SIMPLE_CNT, SUM(AA.GENERAL_CNT) OVER() AS TOTAL_GENERAL_CNT FROM( SELECT IIF(A.CD_TYPE = 'Y', 1, 0) AS SIMPLE_CNT , IIF(ISNULL(A.CD_TYPE, '') != 'Y', 1, 0) AS GENERAL_CNT , A.IN_NO AS IN_NO , A.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO AS CARGO_REFERENCE_NO , CASE WHEN LEN(A.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO) > 15 THEN ( SUBSTRING(A.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO, 1, 11) + '-' + SUBSTRING(A.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO, 12, 4) + '-' + SUBSTRING(A.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO, 16, 4) ) ELSE SUBSTRING(A.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO, 1, 11) + '-' + SUBSTRING(A.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO, 12, 4) END AS CARGO_REFERENCE_NO_DISP , A.OD_JOB_NO AS OD_JOB_NO , A.BL_NO AS BL_NO , A.MBL_NO AS MBL_NO , A.CARRYIN_DATE AS CARRYIN_DATE , A.CARRYIN_TIME AS CARRYIN_TIME , A.CUSTOMER_CODE AS CUSTOMER_CODE , A.CUSTOMER_NAME AS CUSTOMER_NAME , ISNULL(A.STOCK_CT, 0) AS STOCK_CT , ISNULL(A.STOCK_WT, 0) AS STOCK_WT , A.COMMODITY_ITEM_LOC AS COMMODITY_ITEM_LOC
, (SELECT NAME_${userLanguage} FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = #{srchEntCode} AND GROUP_CODE = 'STATUS_ORDER_CARGO' AND CODE = A.LAST_POD_STATUS) AS LAST_POD_STATUS , A.CD_TYPE + '.' + (SELECT NAME_${userLanguage} FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = #{srchEntCode} AND GROUP_CODE = 'CD_TYPE' AND CODE = A.CD_TYPE) AS CD_TYPE , A.CD_USE_TYPE + '.' + (SELECT NAME_${userLanguage} FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = #{srchEntCode} AND GROUP_CODE = 'USE_GUBN' AND CODE = A.CD_USE_TYPE ) AS CD_USE_TYPE , A.ECM_TYPE + '.' + (SELECT NAME_${userLanguage} FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = #{srchEntCode} AND GROUP_CODE = 'CCL_ECOMMERCE_TYPE' AND CODE = A.ECM_TYPE) AS ECM_TYPE
, A.LAST_POD_STATUS AS LAST_POD_STATUS , A.CD_TYPE AS CD_TYPE , A.CD_USE_TYPE AS CD_USE_TYPE , A.ECM_TYPE AS ECM_TYPE
, A.REGISTER_USER_ID AS REGISTER_USER_ID , CASE WHEN (SELECT TOP 1 REFERENCE_NO_ID FROM TB_COM_FILE_SHARE WHERE FUNC_JOB_NO = A.OD_JOB_NO) IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS FILE_SHARE , E.TBST_CARGO_REFERENCE_NO AS CUSTOMS_CARGO_REFERENCE_NO , (SUBSTRING(E.TBST_CARGO_REFERENCE_NO ,1,11) + '-' + SUBSTRING(E.TBST_CARGO_REFERENCE_NO ,12,4) + '-' +SUBSTRING(E.TBST_CARGO_REFERENCE_NO ,16,4)) AS CUSTOMS_CARGO_REFERENCE_NO_DISP , E.TBST_BL_NO AS CUSTOMS_BL_NO , E.TBST_CARRYIN_DATE AS CUSTOMS_CARRYIN_DATE , E.TBST_STOCK_CT AS CUSTOMS_STOCK_CT /*엑셀업로드한 세관재고수량*/ , E.TBST_STOCK_WT AS CUSTOMS_STOCK_WT /*엑셀업로드한 세관재고중량*/ , CASE -- 모든 재고가 맞으면 OK WHEN (A.STOCK_CT = E.TBST_STOCK_CT AND A.STOCK_WT = E.TBST_STOCK_WT AND A.STOCK_CT = SCAN.SCAN_CT ) THEN 'OK' -- 하나라도 재고가 존재할 경우 없는 재고 표시 ELSE LEFT( CONCAT( -- 없음 체크 CASE WHEN ISNULL(A.STOCK_CT, 0) = 0 THEN '창고재고 없음,' ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN ISNULL(SCAN.SCAN_CT, 0) = 0 THEN '실사재고 없음,' ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN ISNULL(E.TBST_STOCK_CT, 0) = 0 THEN '세관재고 없음,' ELSE '' END,
-- 상이 비교는 재고가 존재할 경우만 수행 CASE WHEN ISNULL(A.STOCK_CT, 0) > 0 AND ISNULL(SCAN.SCAN_CT, 0) > 0 AND ISNULL(A.STOCK_CT, 0) <> ISNULL(SCAN.SCAN_CT, 0) THEN '창고-실사 수량 상이,' ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN ISNULL(A.STOCK_CT, 0) > 0 AND ISNULL(E.TBST_STOCK_CT, 0) > 0 AND ISNULL(A.STOCK_CT, 0) <> ISNULL(E.TBST_STOCK_CT, 0) THEN '창고-세관 수량 상이,' ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN ISNULL(A.STOCK_WT, 0) > 0 AND ISNULL(E.TBST_STOCK_WT, 0) > 0 AND ISNULL(A.STOCK_WT, 0) <> ISNULL(E.TBST_STOCK_WT, 0) THEN '창고-세관 중량 상이,' ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN ISNULL(SCAN.SCAN_CT, 0) > 0 AND ISNULL(E.TBST_STOCK_CT, 0) > 0 AND ISNULL(SCAN.SCAN_CT, 0) <> ISNULL(E.TBST_STOCK_CT, 0) THEN '실사-세관 수량 상이,' ELSE '' END ), LEN( CONCAT( CASE WHEN ISNULL(A.STOCK_CT, 0) = 0 THEN '창고재고 없음,' ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN ISNULL(SCAN.SCAN_CT, 0) = 0 THEN '실사재고 없음,' ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN ISNULL(E.TBST_STOCK_CT, 0) = 0 THEN '세관재고 없음,' ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN ISNULL(A.STOCK_CT, 0) > 0 AND ISNULL(SCAN.SCAN_CT, 0) > 0 AND ISNULL(A.STOCK_CT, 0) <> ISNULL(SCAN.SCAN_CT, 0) THEN '창고-실사 수량 상이,' ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN ISNULL(A.STOCK_CT, 0) > 0 AND ISNULL(E.TBST_STOCK_CT, 0) > 0 AND ISNULL(A.STOCK_CT, 0) <> ISNULL(E.TBST_STOCK_CT, 0) THEN '창고-세관 수량 상이,' ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN ISNULL(A.STOCK_WT, 0) > 0 AND ISNULL(E.TBST_STOCK_WT, 0) > 0 AND ISNULL(A.STOCK_WT, 0) <> ISNULL(E.TBST_STOCK_WT, 0) THEN '창고-세관 중량 상이,' ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN ISNULL(SCAN.SCAN_CT, 0) > 0 AND ISNULL(E.TBST_STOCK_CT, 0) > 0 AND ISNULL(SCAN.SCAN_CT, 0) <> ISNULL(E.TBST_STOCK_CT, 0) THEN '실사-세관 수량 상이,' ELSE '' END ) ) - 1 ) END AS CHECK_STATUS , A.CUSTOMS_REPORT_NO AS CUSTOMS_REPORT_NO , A.FWD_CODE AS FWD_CODE , A.FWD_NAME AS FWD_NAME , A.CONSIGNEE_CODE AS CONSIGNEE_CODE , A.CONSIGNEE_NAME AS CONSIGNEE_NAME , A.SHIPPER_CODE AS SHIPPER_CODE , A.SHIPPER_NAME AS SHIPPER_NAME , A.REMARKS_1 AS REMARKS_1 , A.AR_DATE AS AR_DATE , A.IN_PLAN_NO , A.OUT_CLASS AS OUT_CLASS , CASE WHEN A.SAMPLE_OUT_CT =1 THEN '견품반출' ELSE '' END AS SAMPLE_OUT_RESULT , (SELECT SPECIAL_REMARKS FROM TB_BMS_SAMPLE WHERE IN_NO = A.IN_NO ) AS SAMPLE_OUT_REMARKS , SCAN.SCAN_RESULT , SCAN.SCAN_DATE + ' ' + SCAN.SCAN_TIME AS SCAN_DATE , A.LOCATION_PLACE , A.STOCK_REMAIN_PACKING_NO AS PACKING_NO , SCAN.SCAN_REMAIN_PACKING_NO AS SCAN_PACKING_NO , SCAN.SCAN_CT FROM STOCKPKGList A FULL OUTER JOIN EXCELLIST E ON A.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO = E.TBST_CARGO_REFERENCE_NO FULL OUTER JOIN SCANList SCAN ON A.IN_PLAN_NO = SCAN.IN_PLAN_NO OR A.ORIG_IN_PLAN_NO = SCAN.IN_PLAN_NO
) AA

/* BmsStockInspectionMapper.selectCargoStatus : 재고실사 - 진행상태 조회 */ SELECT TOP 1 O.LAST_POD_STATUS AS OUT_LAST_POD_STATUS , OP.APPROVAL_CLASS AS APPROVAL_CLASS , I.LAST_POD_STATUS AS IN_LAST_POD_STATUS FROM TB_BMS_IN I WITH(NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN TB_BMS_OUT_PLAN OP WITH(NOLOCK) ON OP.IN_NO = I.IN_NO LEFT JOIN TB_BMS_OUT O WITH(NOLOCK) ON O.IN_NO = I.IN_NO WHERE I.IN_NO = #{inNo}
